svg.text: Bank-Conflict-Free Shared Memory Without Padding: col ^ row
8×8 tile shown (same idea scales to 32×32, one bank per column); logical column j=3 highlighted in both grids
physical bank = col mod 8 → constant for a fixed column
physical bank = (col ^ row) mod 8 → changes with row
Every access lands on a different bank (b3,b2,b1,b0,b7,b6,b5,b4) → conflict-free
write: tile[row][col ^ row] = value; read: value = tile[row][col ^ row];
Same [TILE][TILE] storage as the unpadded array — no wasted TILE+1'th column, unlike the padding fix from Day 5.
